description: This Kotlin source file defines the EventService class, providing CRUD operations for Event entities within a calendar application. It manages event creation, retrieval, listing, update, and deletion, interacting with an underlying EventRepository.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Service class for managing Event entities, providing create, read, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Event based on the provided EventRequest and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an Event by its UUID, returning an Optional<Event>.

methods.name: listInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of Events that overlap with the specified start and end times.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Event identified by UUID with new data from EventRequest, saving changes to the repository.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Event by its UUID.
